scope: User screenshots plus read-only latest.log display text. Color/action tests are reconstructed fixtures, not captured network packets or a live game test.
note: ChatComponent.logChatMessage escapes embedded newlines; these log entries are separate display messages. Support both the complete closed block and exact centered unsigned SYSTEM_SERVER reward lines. Unpadded REWARD/Health, player/client/signed messages, unknown words and actions remain original. No historical state or per-frame scan.
